name: Font Mojo Component

title.zh: Font Mojo · 输入同一句文字

description.zh: 调整字号与颜色，再核对字体包许可和导出图片授权。 输入文字比较字形的网页工具，提供精选字体目录、字号与颜色控制及预览导出入口，官网声明应用免费。Sono 本次已从真实详情入口取得 ZIP，包内为 OFL 1.1，与页面的 public domain 说法不同；该包许可不覆盖工具软件、其他字体或导出图片授权。
description.en: A web tool for comparing typefaces with custom text, a featured-font directory, size and color controls, and preview export. The official About page states the app is free. The Sono ZIP obtained from its actual detail link contains OFL 1.1, contrary to the page’s public-domain claim; that package license does not cover tool software, other fonts, or exported-image permissions.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Font Mojo (https://fontmojo.com/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 调整字号与颜色，再核对字体包许可和导出图片授权。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先在首页看到文字输入框，再到精选目录把同一句话的粗体、手写和颗粒字形并排比较。建议开 Sono，用顶部字号滑杆和左下色点检查自己要用的文字，导出入口在右上。我们已从详情下载链接取得字体包，包内实际是 OFL，不是页面所说的公有领域；这只覆盖该包，其他字体和预览图片的授权仍要分别核对。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
